meaning: The first letter of the native Aklanon alphabet, representing the low central unrounded vowel /a/.
An exclamation of discovery; "ah" (with high intonation).
to get or climb up on one's back
An exclamation expressing strong disbelief: "Really?" "Ah, go on!"
to flare up, grow, get bigger (fire)
abaca fibres, Manila hemp; Musa textiles
to be abundant, be in abundance
alphabet; name of the first grade textbook
to take responsibility, shoulder, take on

examples.akl: Sín-o ro gaabága ku trabáho ngarón?
examples.eng: Who will take on that job?
